name: Eclair Burnett
original_name: エクレール・バーネット
source:
★The kind-hearted, busty school nurse who is a widow and mother of two★

A widow with two young children. Her husband died in a war some time ago.

At the academy, she works as both a teacher and school nurse, taking care of the students while educating them.

Her mature body and voluptuous breasts and ass are the kind of traits you'd expect from a woman of her age. Her gentle, warm personality exudes maternal love, making her very popular with students.

For Tsukasa, who has acquired an unwanted power, she worries about him and always looks out for him. Her daughters, Maple and Maron, also seem to like Tsukasa very much, and often come over to play with him.

[Translated from https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/mwa/index.html]
